rows.summary: A flatbed semi-trailer carries a stacked steel frame load of beams and plates, secured with chains on the visible sides, with no rope or headboard violation visible.
Round timber logs are stacked in several layers on a flatbed trailer behind a pickup, held by about three top-over ratchet straps, with a coil of rope and a chainsaw separate from the load.

A single Caterpillar 637K wheeled scraper sits on a blue-tractor lowboy semi-trailer, and no straps, chains or blocking are clearly visible in this side view, so its securement cannot be confirmed from this photo.
A tall stack of compressed straw blocks fills the flatbed and is secured by green rope and a single diagonal strap, with wooden battens across the top.
A small white pickup carries several large bundled sacks of recyclable material stacked above the bed, held by olive straps and green cord lashings that may be rope.
A Scania semi-trailer carries a stacked bundle of round tree logs lying lengthwise, contained by orange Trailis stakes on both sides, with no straps, chains or ropes visible in this photo.
A small flatbed truck carries a tall, loose stack of round logs and rough boards that rises above the cab, with no clearly visible straps or chains securing it.
A flatbed truck carries one large bundle of bamboo poles that overhangs the rear of the bed, secured by about four straps passed over the top of the bundle.
Three layers of long green steel pipes are stacked on a flatbed trailer and secured by about five webbing straps routed over the load, with no ropes visible.
A flatbed truck carries a stack of large round concrete-style pipes lying across the bed, and no straps, chains or ropes are visible in this side photo.
A small flatbed truck carries several stacks of boxed appliances behind a metal cage frame and a tarp, with little visible securement beyond the cage and possible strap ends.
A semi-trailer carries a tall stack of hay bales, apparently held by a few thin lines passing over the top, which may be rope rather than strap.
A flatbed semi carries three stacks of sawn lumber, secured by several webbing straps running over the top of the load; the anchor points and the headboard position are not visible.
A yellow JCB backhoe loader sits on an open low-bed trailer, secured by chains and a strap whose exact routing is hard to confirm from this side view.
The flatbed carries a block of about six stacked plastic crate units along its length, secured by six rope lashings running over the top of the load.
A semi-trailer with high sides carries a large load covered by a blue tarpaulin, held down by several straps running over the top, but the cargo itself cannot be identified.
Four open steel racks holding tall grey bars stand upright on a flatbed semi-trailer, with orange cylinders at the base of the racks, and no straps or chains are clearly visible in this photo.
The box van carries a loose pile of plastic-wrapped ceramic blocks against the rear, with no straps, chains or blocking visible in the photo.
Straw bales are stacked several tiers high on a small flatbed and held by horizontal bands running over the load, which may be rope or wire.
A motor grader and a long steel tube sit on a lowbed semi-trailer, with a large round item near the tractor, and the grader appears held by chains anchored diagonally to the deck.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries a tall stack of sawn lumber bundles that is held by white bands, but the top and full length are not visible in this side photo.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries stacked fabricated steel beams and plates on timber dunnage, secured with chains running over the load to the trailer sides.
A pile of large tree logs on a gooseneck flatbed trailer towed by a pickup, secured with a couple of ratchet straps over the front logs.
A yellow Caterpillar 637K wheeled scraper sits on a multi-axle lowboy semi-trailer, apparently held by a few chains that are hard to see from this distance.
A flatbed truck carries a very tall, wide stack of straw bales that overhangs the bed, held mainly by thin ropes and cords plus one strap and wooden poles.
A small pickup carries a huge pile of bulk bags stacked far above the bed and rack, held by a few thin ropes and green straps.
A semi-trailer log truck carries a tall bundle of round logs held between orange side stakes, with only a possible strap end visible and no clear top-over lashing.
A small two-axle truck carries a tall, loose pile of logs, poles and boards that extends above the headboard and past the rear, with no clear restraints visible.
A flatbed truck with a blue crane carries one huge bundle of bamboo poles that overhangs the rear, held by several thin rope-like lashings.
A stack of large green steel pipes lies lengthwise on a red flatbed semi-trailer, held down by several yellow and tan straps going over the top.
Several large concrete pipes lie lengthwise in two rows on a flatbed crane truck, and no straps, chains or ropes can be seen in this side view.

A small flatbed truck with side rails carries tall stacks of large appliance cartons, mostly hidden by a tarp and a rear frame, with no clear lashings visible apart from a loose strap and a chain at the rear.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries a very tall, wide stack of hay bales that appears to be held only by thin rope or twine, with no clearly visible straps.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries stacked bundles of sawn lumber, secured with several flat straps going over the top.
A yellow JCB backhoe loader sits on a low-bed trailer, secured with a couple of chains at the axles and a strap from the bucket, with the other side and headboard not visible.
A flatbed truck carries tall stacks of plastic crates, lashed only with a few ropes over the top, which breaks the rule against rope lashing.
A tractor-trailer carries a load completely covered by a dark tarpaulin and held down by several rope-like lines, so the cargo itself cannot be identified.

A semi-trailer flatbed carries a row of rusty steel racks holding tall grey slabs, apparently secured by the racks themselves with a hanging chain and possibly a few straps, but the securing is not clearly visible.
A closed box truck is loaded with a loose heap of short plastic profile pieces filling the rear of the van, with no visible straps, chains or ropes securing it.
A very tall, wide stack of round straw bales is piled on a flatbed truck and appears to be held only by a few thin horizontal ropes.
A Komatsu motor grader sits on a low-loader semi-trailer and appears to be secured with a few chains, but the lashing points cannot be fully checked from this side view.
Stacked bundles of sawn lumber on an aluminium flatbed semi-trailer, apparently held by white webbing straps going over the top, but the photo shows only the side.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries stacked fabricated structural steel members on wooden dunnage, secured with chains over the load.
A gooseneck flatbed trailer carries a loose pile of about a dozen logs lying lengthwise, held by about three ratchet straps over the top with an open gap ahead of the load.
A CAT 637K wheeled scraper on a multi-axle lowboy semi-trailer, secured with chains that are only partly visible from the side.
A truck carrying a very tall, overhanging stack of hay bales held mainly by ropes, poles and a couple of straps.
A pickup is overloaded with large bulk bags of recyclables stacked high above the cab and overhanging the rear, held only loosely by ropes and the bed rack.
A semi-trailer timber carrier loaded with logs held between steel stanchions, with only a few possible straps visible from this angle.
A small dump-style truck carries a loose, overhanging pile of round wooden poles and boards with at most one visible thin lashing at the rear.
A rigid flatbed crane truck carries a huge bundle of long bamboo poles overhanging the rear, tied around with about five ropes or wire lashings.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries a stack of large green steel pipes lying lengthwise, secured with at least four yellow/brown top-over straps hooked to the side rail.
A crane flatbed truck carries concrete pipes in two tiers lying across the bed, with lashings mostly not visible from this side.
A small drop-side truck carries tall stacks of appliance cartons held in by a metal cage extension and a tarp tied with cords, with no visible straps.
A semi-trailer flatbed carries a tall stack of hay bales, apparently held only by a few ropes across the rear, with no straps visible.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries about six stacked bundles of sawn lumber secured with roughly ten top-over straps.
A JCB backhoe loader stands on a lowbed semi-trailer, held by diagonal chains at the front and rear plus a possible strap near the bucket; the other side cannot be seen.
A small flatbed truck carries tall stacks of empty plastic crates secured only with about six ropes over the top.
A semi-trailer carries an unidentified tarp-covered load, likely bulk or sacks, held down by multiple ropes over the tarp.
A flatbed semi-trailer carries about five steel racks of tall upright metal bars on its front two thirds, with only a few visible chain/strap lashings.
A closed box truck carries a loose pile of plastic-wrapped window profiles filling the bed to about half height, with no visible straps or other restraints.
A small truck piled high with round straw bales extending beyond its sides, held only by thin ropes or wires wrapped around the load.
A Komatsu motor grader is carried on a lowboy semi-trailer, secured by at least two chains visible on this side.

A flatbed carries at least four stacked bundles of sawn lumber held by their own banding; no tie-down straps, chains, headboard or bundle ends are visible in this cropped side view, so securement cannot be judged.
